summary: This bill increases the qualified business income deduction from 20% to 30% and the W-2 wage limitation from 50% to 100% for domestic manufacturers that produce tangible property and incur at least 20% of their cost of goods sold in the U.S. for labor and overhead.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to enhance the qualified business income deduction for domestic manufacturers, effectively lowering their tax burden. This is the primary purpose of the bill.

The bill's sole purpose is to expand the Section 199A qualified business income deduction from 20% to 30% (with related adjustments) for domestic manufacturers, which reduces federal tax revenue with no offsetting spending cuts or revenue raisers. This directly increases the deficit to provide tax relief to a targeted group of businesses.
